description: This file contains functions for quoting and unquoting strings, especially for shell safety and language-specific string literals, as well as related utilities for path quoting and escaping.

methods.name: need_bs_quote
methods.description: Checks if a character needs backslash escaping in quotes.

methods.name: sq_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a string for shell safety, handling single quotes and exclamation points.

methods.name: sq_quote_buf_pretty
methods.description: Quotes a string if necessary, otherwise copies it directly.

methods.name: sq_quotef
methods.description: Formats and quotes a string with printf-style formatting.

methods.name: sq_quote_argv
methods.description: Quotes an array of arguments into a single string.

methods.name: sq_quote_argv_pretty
methods.description: Quotes an array of arguments with leading whitespace.

methods.name: sq_append_quote_argv_pretty
methods.description: Appends an array of arguments with quotes and spaces.

methods.name: sq_dequote_step
methods.description: Dequotes a single-quoted string, handling escapes.

methods.name: sq_dequote
methods.description: Dequotes a string.

methods.name: sq_dequote_to_argv
methods.description: Dequotes a string into an argument array.

methods.name: sq_dequote_to_strvec
methods.description: Dequotes a string into a string vector.

methods.name: quote_c_style
methods.description: Quotes a string in C-style with double quotes and escapes.

methods.name: quote_two_c_style
methods.description: Quotes two strings with C-style quoting, optionally enclosing in quotes.

methods.name: write_name_quoted
methods.description: Writes a quoted name to a file, with optional terminator.

methods.name: write_name_quoted_relative
methods.description: Writes a relative path name quoted to a file.

methods.name: quote_path
methods.description: Quotes a path relative to a prefix, with escaping.

methods.name: unquote_c_style
methods.description: Unquotes a C-style quoted string.

methods.name: perl_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a string as a Perl string literal.

methods.name: perl_quote_buf_with_len
methods.description: Quotes a string as a Perl string literal with specified length.

methods.name: python_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a string as a Python string literal.

methods.name: tcl_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a string as a Tcl string literal.

methods.name: basic_regex_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a string for use in basic regular expressions.
